column2:
Flooding the outer districts has severely crippled the Arachnids’ offensive, but the Brain Bug manages to strike back once more: Its remaining hordes have overrun the starport in the heart of Mahanagar.

This facility, vital for the flow of reinforcements and supplies, demands immediate recapture to maintain the upper hand.
Activate one of the fire alarms
Defend the fire alarm until the Flight Control Room is secured
Clear all Bug Hives and Bug Vents
Clear the Bug Hive on the runway

column2: We're in the starport's metro station now. Intel was right, Bugs are dug in deep down here.
Secure your zone, Keys. I'll be making my landing soon!
I can't join in the fun while there's Bugs on the airstrip. You figure you can run a lil fire drill and draw the Bugs toward you a moment?
You want us to play bait? If that’s what it takes, that’s what we’ll do...
It's over for us down here, Major!
Don't die on me, Keys! We're nearly there!
Damnit, Major! Where are you! We're done for!!
Damnit, soldier! Don't give up now!
And the crowd's comin' runnin'! Bugs are clearing the airstrip and coming to you!
Make your landing quick then! We can only hold so long.
You think I'd leave you in the lurch? I'll be in to save your ass soon enough!
More worried you might miss us killing everything before you, Major!
We'll work on taking that Flight Control room asap!
Flight Control secured! And here comes the full might of the M.I., thundering down on the Bugs!
About time we had the numbers in a fight! We can begin clearing the starport now!
Starport secured -- the M.I. is back running things in Mahanagar.
Ol' wrinkle-skin best be quaking in his slug hole. We're comin' for him now.
Leave at least some of him left for me. My city has lost everything because of this blasted Brain Bug.
You'll get your shot, Keys. I'll see to that.
Rainmaker delivery -- now that's what this op's been missing!
Arm up and throw the last of these ugly suckers off my runway!
Operation "Kick Bug Ass" is officially back up and running!
